user.title: Connect to AxonHub
user.description: Sign in with an AxonHub account that is allowed to read channels. The owner account works out of the box. Requires AxonHub v0.8.7 or newer.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate AxonHub
reauth_confirm.description: AxonHub at {url} rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

error.invalid_url: The AxonHub URL is not valid
error.insufficient_permissions: This account is not allowed to read channels
error.unsupported_version: This AxonHub instance does not expose the provider quota API. AxonHub {minimum_version} or newer is required — please upgrade AxonHub.

abort.already_configured: This AxonHub instance is already configured
abort.reauth_entry_missing: The AxonHub configuration entry no longer exists

refresh_quotas.name: Refresh provider quotas
refresh_quotas.description: Ask AxonHub to re-check the provider quota of every channel right now instead of waiting for the periodic background check.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Only refresh this AxonHub instance. Leave empty to refresh every configured instance.
